import_warnings: IMP-01 duplicates CHG-07 (Theory of Change); merged

records.name: Porter's Five Forces
records.structures: Industry rivalry, threat of entrants and substitutes, buyer power, supplier power
records.evidence_needs: Market structure, competitor evidence, switching costs, industry economics; mostly qualitative unless data are available
records.summary: Industry rivalry, threat of entrants and substitutes, buyer power, supplier power

records.name: Porter's Generic Strategies
records.structures: Cost leadership, differentiation, and focus choices
records.evidence_needs: Cost position, willingness to pay, segment economics, evidence of trade-offs
records.summary: Cost leadership, differentiation, and focus choices

records.name: Porter's Value Chain
records.structures: How primary and support activities contribute to cost or differentiation
records.evidence_needs: Activity costs, margin/cost drivers, process data where available
records.summary: How primary and support activities contribute to cost or differentiation

records.name: Porter's Strategic Positioning / Activity-System Fit
records.structures: The chosen position and fit among the activities supporting it
records.evidence_needs: Competitor comparisons and evidence of mutually reinforcing activities
records.summary: The chosen position and fit among the activities supporting it

records.name: Porter's Diamond
records.structures: National/industry competitiveness through factor conditions, demand conditions, related industries, and firm rivalry/context
records.evidence_needs: Industry, trade, workforce, supplier, demand and policy data where relevant
records.summary: National/industry competitiveness through factor conditions, demand conditions, related industries, and firm rivalry/context

records.name: PESTEL
records.structures: Political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal context
records.evidence_needs: Dated, cited external evidence; identify uncertainty and time horizon
records.summary: Political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal context

records.name: SWOT / TOWS
records.structures: Internal strengths/weaknesses and external opportunities/threats; TOWS turns them into options
records.evidence_needs: Evidence for each item; strategic options must follow from the analysis rather than be generic
records.summary: Internal strengths/weaknesses and external opportunities/threats; TOWS turns them into options

records.name: VRIO
records.structures: Whether a resource/capability is valuable, rare, hard to imitate, and organizationally supported
records.evidence_needs: Evidence about resources, competitors, imitation, and organizational use; avoid unsupported yes/no scoring
records.summary: Whether a resource/capability is valuable, rare, hard to imitate, and organizationally supported

records.name: Ansoff Matrix
records.structures: Market penetration, market development, product development, diversification
records.evidence_needs: Growth potential, risks, capability requirements, market/customer evidence
records.summary: Market penetration, market development, product development, diversification

records.name: BCG Growth-Share Matrix
records.structures: Portfolio positioning using market growth and relative market share
records.evidence_needs: Definitions and estimates of market growth and relative share; disclose boundaries and limitations
records.summary: Portfolio positioning using market growth and relative market share

records.name: GE–McKinsey Portfolio Matrix
records.structures: Portfolio assessment using industry attractiveness and business strength
records.evidence_needs: Explicit criteria and weights; sensitivity to scoring and weight changes
records.summary: Portfolio assessment using industry attractiveness and business strength

records.name: Strategic Group Mapping
records.structures: Competitor groups by selected strategic dimensions
records.evidence_needs: Comparable competitor data; axis choice must be justified
records.summary: Competitor groups by selected strategic dimensions

records.name: Blue Ocean Strategy Canvas / ERRC Grid
records.structures: Current competitive factors and possible eliminate-reduce-raise-create choices
records.evidence_needs: Customer evidence, competitor benchmarks, cost and value hypotheses; validate with customers
records.summary: Current competitive factors and possible eliminate-reduce-raise-create choices

records.name: Scenario Planning
records.structures: Several plausible futures, their drivers, implications, and robust choices
records.evidence_needs: Sources for drivers, scenario assumptions, sensitivity analysis; scenarios are not forecasts
records.summary: Several plausible futures, their drivers, implications, and robust choices

records.name: Business Model Canvas
records.structures: Nine connected business-model blocks covering customers, value, delivery, resources, activities, partners, costs and revenue
records.evidence_needs: Customer evidence, revenue logic, cost estimates, and consistency across blocks
records.summary: Nine connected business-model blocks covering customers, value, delivery, resources, activities, partners, costs and revenue

records.name: Lean Canvas
records.structures: Startup problem, customer, value proposition, solution, channels, revenue/cost, metrics and advantage assumptions
records.evidence_needs: Customer validation, unit economics, explicit hypotheses
records.summary: Startup problem, customer, value proposition, solution, channels, revenue/cost, metrics and advantage assumptions

records.name: Value Proposition Canvas
records.structures: Customer jobs, pains and gains compared with pain relievers and gain creators
records.evidence_needs: Customer interviews/observations and validation; a canvas is a hypothesis, not proof of product-market fit
records.summary: Customer jobs, pains and gains compared with pain relievers and gain creators

records.name: SWOT evidence-to-action review
records.structures: Audit each SWOT item for evidence, materiality, and resulting strategic options
records.evidence_needs: Evidence traceability and prioritization; use as a quality layer on SWOT/TOWS, not a separate theory
records.summary: Audit each SWOT item for evidence, materiality, and resulting strategic options

records.name: Strategic positioning review
records.structures: The place claimed in the market, the difference it rests on, the value promised and the segment it is aimed at
records.evidence_needs: Evidence that the difference is valued by the segment and that the segment is reachable; a positioning claim is a hypothesis to test
records.summary: The place claimed in the market, the difference it rests on, the value promised and the segment it is aimed at

records.name: Strategy framework: perspective, position, plan and pattern
records.structures: A strategy read through its perspective, the position it claims, the plan that delivers it and the pattern of behaviour it creates
records.evidence_needs: Evidence that the plan produces the intended pattern and that the position holds in the market; a strategy is read, not scored
records.summary: A strategy read through its perspective, the position it claims, the plan that delivers it and the pattern of behaviour it creates

records.name: Kotter's 8-Step Change Model
records.structures: A sequence for mobilizing, implementing and sustaining organizational change
records.evidence_needs: Stakeholder evidence, progress measures, adoption and outcome indicators
records.summary: A sequence for mobilizing, implementing and sustaining organizational change

records.name: ADKAR
records.structures: Individual change readiness/barriers: Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement
records.evidence_needs: Employee input or structured assessment; avoid treating self-report scores as objective facts
records.summary: Individual change readiness/barriers: Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement

records.name: Lewin's Three-Stage Model
records.structures: Unfreezing, changing and stabilizing new practices
records.evidence_needs: Diagnosis of current norms, transition actions, reinforcement measures; use as a simplifying lens, not a universal law
records.summary: Unfreezing, changing and stabilizing new practices

records.name: McKinsey 7-S
records.structures: Alignment among strategy, structure, systems, shared values, skills, style and staff
records.evidence_needs: Evidence across the seven dimensions and their alignment; no single score is inherently authoritative
records.summary: Alignment among strategy, structure, systems, shared values, skills, style and staff

records.name: Burke–Litwin Organizational Performance and Change Model
records.structures: Relationships among external environment, leadership, mission/strategy, culture, systems and performance
records.evidence_needs: Organizational data and stakeholder evidence; causal relationships require caution
records.summary: Relationships among external environment, leadership, mission/strategy, culture, systems and performance

records.name: Galbraith Star Model
records.structures: Alignment of strategy, structure, processes, rewards and people practices
records.evidence_needs: Operating model, roles, process and reward evidence
records.summary: Alignment of strategy, structure, processes, rewards and people practices

records.name: Theory of Change
records.structures: Causal pathway from activities to outputs, outcomes and impact, including assumptions
records.evidence_needs: Outcome indicators, assumptions, contextual evidence, and evaluation design; links are hypotheses to test
records.summary: Causal pathway from activities to outputs, outcomes and impact, including assumptions

structures_alt.text: Causal pathway, assumptions, contextual factors and intended outcomes/impact

evidence_needs_alt.text: Outcomes, indicators and evaluation design; pathways are hypotheses

records.name: Logic Model
records.structures: Inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes and impact
records.evidence_needs: Measurable indicators, data sources, time horizons; distinguish activities from outcomes
records.summary: Inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes and impact

structures_alt.text: Inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes and impacts

evidence_needs_alt.text: Indicator definitions, data sources and time horizons

records.name: Plan–Do–Study–Act (PDSA)
records.structures: Small, iterative tests of change
records.evidence_needs: Baseline, defined prediction, measures, results, and decision for the next cycle
records.summary: Small, iterative tests of change

records.name: DMAIC
records.structures: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control for process/problem improvement
records.evidence_needs: Baseline data, valid measures, root-cause evidence and control measures
records.summary: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control for process/problem improvement

records.name: Organizational Design: Star/fit review
records.structures: Check alignment among strategy, decision rights, structure, processes, people and incentives
records.evidence_needs: Operating data and clear mapping of responsibilities
records.summary: Check alignment among strategy, decision rights, structure, processes, people and incentives

records.name: Competing Values Framework
records.structures: Organizational culture through competing value orientations
records.evidence_needs: Survey/observation evidence; treat profiles as diagnostic, not immutable types
records.summary: Organizational culture through competing value orientations

records.name: Mintzberg Organizational Configurations
records.structures: Compare organizational structure/configuration patterns
records.evidence_needs: Evidence about coordination, key parts, decision authority and context
records.summary: Compare organizational structure/configuration patterns

records.name: RACI responsibility matrix
records.structures: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed roles
records.evidence_needs: Role clarity and stakeholder confirmation; usually no calculations required
records.summary: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed roles

records.name: Change and organization review
records.structures: The kind of change, the readiness of the organization, the points of resistance and the support the change needs
records.evidence_needs: Evidence about readiness and resistance from the people affected and from comparable changes; no readiness score is computed
records.summary: The kind of change, the readiness of the organization, the points of resistance and the support the change needs

records.name: Segmentation–Targeting–Positioning (STP)
records.structures: Customer segments, target selection, and desired market position
records.evidence_needs: Segment size/profitability, needs and fit, competition, segment-selection criteria
records.summary: Customer segments, target selection, and desired market position

records.name: Marketing Mix: 4Ps / Services Mix: 7Ps
records.structures: Product, Price, Place, Promotion; services add People, Process and Physical Evidence
records.evidence_needs: Customer, competitor and cost evidence; price and channel economics as appropriate
records.summary: Product, Price, Place, Promotion; services add People, Process and Physical Evidence

records.name: AIDA
records.structures: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action as a simplified communication journey
records.evidence_needs: Funnel/conversion data if available; avoid assuming all customers move linearly through stages
records.summary: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action as a simplified communication journey

records.name: Customer Journey Mapping
records.structures: Customer goals, actions, touchpoints, experiences, pain points and opportunities
records.evidence_needs: Interviews, observations, service logs, funnel metrics, customer feedback
records.summary: Customer goals, actions, touchpoints, experiences, pain points and opportunities

records.name: Marketing / Sales Funnel
records.structures: Conversion through defined stages
records.evidence_needs: Stage definitions, conversion rates, cohort/time windows, leakage analysis
records.summary: Conversion through defined stages

records.name: Kano Model
records.structures: Product/service attributes by their relationship to customer satisfaction
records.evidence_needs: Appropriate survey design and customer samples; classifications can vary by segment and time
records.summary: Product/service attributes by their relationship to customer satisfaction

records.name: SERVQUAL
records.structures: Service-quality assessment using defined dimensions and perception/expectation measures
records.evidence_needs: Survey instrument, sampling and scoring choices; validity and context need review
records.summary: Service-quality assessment using defined dimensions and perception/expectation measures

records.name: RFM Segmentation
records.structures: Customer groups based on recency, frequency and monetary value
records.evidence_needs: Transaction data, window definitions, scoring method and checks for biased segments
records.summary: Customer groups based on recency, frequency and monetary value

structures_alt.text: RFM Segmentation. Explain the scoring boundaries and the stability of the segments.

records.name: Technology Acceptance Model (TAM)
records.structures: Perceived usefulness/ease of use and related technology-acceptance constructs
records.evidence_needs: Validated scales and appropriate study design if used for empirical assessment
records.summary: Perceived usefulness/ease of use and related technology-acceptance constructs

records.name: UTAUT
records.structures: Structured constructs associated with technology acceptance and use
records.evidence_needs: Validated measurement scales and research design; not a generic checklist for all adoption problems
records.summary: Structured constructs associated with technology acceptance and use

records.name: Brand Equity Assessment
records.structures: Selected dimensions of brand knowledge, associations, perceived quality and loyalty
records.evidence_needs: Customer research and clearly defined measurement; choose a specified model rather than mixing variants
records.summary: Selected dimensions of brand knowledge, associations, perceived quality and loyalty

records.name: STP-to-positioning evidence check
records.structures: Check that target choice, customer evidence and positioning claim align
records.evidence_needs: Research on target segments and competitive alternatives
records.summary: Check that target choice, customer evidence and positioning claim align

records.name: Digital marketing mix: owned, earned and paid channels
records.structures: The channels you control, the channels others create and the channels you pay for, with the role and budget of each
records.evidence_needs: Channel inventory, audience and reach evidence, cost data and a declared objective for each channel
records.summary: The channels you control, the channels others create and the channels you pay for, with the role and budget of each

records.name: SEO and content marketing plan
records.structures: The content that answers a search or customer question, the keywords it targets and the page that carries it
records.evidence_needs: Keyword and search-demand evidence, page inventory, content calendar, ranking and traffic data
records.summary: The content that answers a search or customer question, the keywords it targets and the page that carries it

records.name: Paid media plan: search, social and display
records.structures: Campaign objective, audience, placement, budget and bid, by paid channel
records.evidence_needs: Platform cost data, audience definitions, creative variants and a declared conversion definition
records.summary: Campaign objective, audience, placement, budget and bid, by paid channel

records.name: Email, CRM and lifecycle marketing
records.structures: List growth, segmentation, journey stages and the message sent at each stage
records.evidence_needs: List and consent records, send/open/click counts, unsubscribe and bounce counts, revenue by journey
records.summary: List growth, segmentation, journey stages and the message sent at each stage

records.name: Social media and influencer marketing
records.structures: Owned posts, community activity and creator partnerships, with the metric each is judged on
records.evidence_needs: Reach, engagement and follower data; creator terms, fees and disclosure requirements
records.summary: Owned posts, community activity and creator partnerships, with the metric each is judged on

records.name: Web and app analytics measurement plan
records.structures: The events, metrics and dimensions that make a journey measurable, and the question each answers
records.evidence_needs: A defined event taxonomy, tool access, consent and data-quality checks
records.summary: The events, metrics and dimensions that make a journey measurable, and the question each answers

records.name: Attribution and campaign measurement
records.structures: Which touchpoints receive credit, under which rule, and what the campaign changed
records.evidence_needs: UTM discipline, touchpoint logs, conversion definitions, a declared attribution model and, for causality, a holdout or experiment
records.summary: Which touchpoints receive credit, under which rule, and what the campaign changed

records.name: Conversion-rate optimisation and landing-page testing
records.structures: The page or step to change, the hypothesis and the test that decides it
records.evidence_needs: Baseline conversion counts, traffic split, test duration and a declared minimum detectable effect
records.summary: The page or step to change, the hypothesis and the test that decides it

records.name: Marketing automation and lead scoring
records.structures: The rules that move a lead between stages and the score that qualifies it
records.evidence_needs: Lead-source and behaviour data, stage definitions (MQL/SQL), sales feedback and score validation
records.summary: The rules that move a lead between stages and the score that qualifies it

records.name: SCOR Digital Standard
records.structures: Supply-chain processes, capabilities and performance measures
records.evidence_needs: Defined process scope, metrics, data definitions and benchmarks; verify the applicable version and permitted use
records.summary: Supply-chain processes, capabilities and performance measures

records.name: SIPOC
records.structures: Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs, Customers
records.evidence_needs: Process-owner confirmation, scope and customer requirements
records.summary: Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs, Customers

records.name: Value Stream Mapping
records.structures: Material/information flow, delay, work-in-progress and value-adding/non-value-adding steps
records.evidence_needs: Cycle time, lead time, inventory and process observations
records.summary: Material/information flow, delay, work-in-progress and value-adding/non-value-adding steps

records.name: 5S
records.structures: Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain
records.evidence_needs: Workplace observations, audit criteria and sustaining measures
records.summary: Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain

records.name: Lean problem-solving / A3
records.structures: Problem, current condition, target, cause, countermeasures, implementation and follow-up
records.evidence_needs: Baseline and outcome measures; evidence that root causes were tested
records.summary: Problem, current condition, target, cause, countermeasures, implementation and follow-up

records.name: Theory of Constraints — Five Focusing Steps
records.structures: Identify, exploit, subordinate, elevate and reassess the system constraint
records.evidence_needs: Throughput, capacity, queue and bottleneck data; distinguish this procedure from the broader theory alone
records.summary: Identify, exploit, subordinate, elevate and reassess the system constraint

records.name: Root Cause Analysis: 5 Whys / Fishbone
records.structures: Organize candidate causes and investigate contributing factors
records.evidence_needs: Evidence testing each causal hypothesis; a diagram alone does not establish cause
records.summary: Organize candidate causes and investigate contributing factors

records.name: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
records.structures: Potential failure modes, effects, causes and controls
records.evidence_needs: Severity/occurrence/detection criteria; score products are prioritization aids, not precise probabilities
records.summary: Potential failure modes, effects, causes and controls

records.name: Statistical Process Control (SPC)
records.structures: Distinguish common-cause and special-cause process variation
records.evidence_needs: Time-ordered observations, suitable control charts, stable-process assumptions
records.summary: Distinguish common-cause and special-cause process variation

records.name: Kraljic Purchasing Portfolio Matrix
records.structures: Supplier categories based on supply risk and profit/impact
records.evidence_needs: Purchasing-spend, supply risk and strategic-impact evidence; criteria must be defined
records.summary: Supplier categories based on supply risk and profit/impact

records.name: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP)
records.structures: Reconcile demand, supply, inventory, capacity and financial plans
records.evidence_needs: Forecasts, capacity and inventory data, scenario comparisons
records.summary: Reconcile demand, supply, inventory, capacity and financial plans

records.name: PDCA / PDSA
records.structures: Iterative improvement cycle
records.evidence_needs: Measures before and after intervention; see also change catalogue
records.summary: Iterative improvement cycle

records.name: ISO 31000 Risk Management Process
records.structures: Establish context; identify, analyze, evaluate, treat, monitor and communicate risk
records.evidence_needs: Risk criteria, evidence, owners, treatment plans and monitoring measures; check current edition before use
records.summary: Establish context; identify, analyze, evaluate, treat, monitor and communicate risk

records.name: COSO Enterprise Risk Management
records.structures: Integrate risk with governance, strategy, performance and review
records.evidence_needs: Strategy/objective mapping, risk appetite, ownership and performance evidence; use authoritative current materials
records.summary: Integrate risk with governance, strategy, performance and review

records.name: Bow-Tie Analysis
records.structures: Threats, preventive controls, top event, consequences and mitigative controls
records.evidence_needs: Incident/engineering evidence; probability estimates only where supported
records.summary: Threats, preventive controls, top event, consequences and mitigative controls

records.name: Fault Tree Analysis
records.structures: Logical combinations of failures that can lead to a top event
records.evidence_needs: System logic and failure probabilities if quantitative; assumptions must be explicit
records.summary: Logical combinations of failures that can lead to a top event

records.name: Stakeholder Analysis / Power–Interest Matrix
records.structures: Identify stakeholders, interests, influence, impacts and engagement response
records.evidence_needs: Source-supported stakeholder facts; power/interest classifications are judgments
records.summary: Identify stakeholders, interests, influence, impacts and engagement response

records.name: Materiality Assessment
records.structures: Prioritize issues by their importance to affected stakeholders and/or enterprise impacts
records.evidence_needs: Defined methodology, stakeholder evidence and current reporting requirements where applicable
records.summary: Prioritize issues by their importance to affected stakeholders and/or enterprise impacts

records.name: Red-Team / Premortem Review
records.structures: Challenge a proposed plan and identify how it could fail
records.evidence_needs: Independent reviewers, documented challenge prompts and resolutions
records.summary: Challenge a proposed plan and identify how it could fail

records.name: Dialectical Inquiry / Devil's Advocate
records.structures: Deliberately develop and test competing interpretations or strategies
records.evidence_needs: Shared criteria, balanced evidence and explicit handling of unresolved disagreement
records.summary: Deliberately develop and test competing interpretations or strategies

records.name: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA)
records.structures: Compare options against criteria and explicit weights
records.evidence_needs: Score definitions, weights, normalization, sensitivity analysis and user-owned value judgments
records.summary: Compare options against criteria and explicit weights

records.name: Balanced Scorecard
records.structures: Objectives and measures across financial, customer/stakeholder, internal-process and organizational-capacity perspectives
records.evidence_needs: Strategy-linked metrics, targets, initiatives, time windows and data owners
records.summary: Objectives and measures across financial, customer/stakeholder, internal-process and organizational-capacity perspectives

records.name: Strategy Map
records.structures: Hypothesized links among strategic objectives and outcomes
records.evidence_needs: Evidence for causal links; describe these as hypotheses until tested
records.summary: Hypothesized links among strategic objectives and outcomes

records.name: KPI Tree / Driver Tree
records.structures: Link a top-level outcome to measurable drivers and sub-drivers
records.evidence_needs: Metric definitions, decomposition checks and source lineage
records.summary: Link a top-level outcome to measurable drivers and sub-drivers

records.name: Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)
records.structures: Objectives and measurable key results over a defined period
records.evidence_needs: Baselines, targets, owners, measurement cadence and gaming risks
records.summary: Objectives and measurable key results over a defined period

records.name: PRINCE2
records.structures: Project governance, roles, stages, business justification, controls and tailoring
records.evidence_needs: Project evidence and governance decisions; use an appropriate, authorized level of detail
records.summary: Project governance, roles, stages, business justification, controls and tailoring

records.name: PMBOK / PMI project management standards
records.type_note: reference standard
records.structures: Project-management knowledge areas, principles and performance domains depending on edition
records.evidence_needs: Version-specific guidance; it is not one fixed universal checklist
records.summary: Project-management knowledge areas, principles and performance domains depending on edition

records.name: Scrum
records.structures: Defined accountabilities, events, artifacts and empirical product-development cycle
records.evidence_needs: Sprint goals, increments, backlog and outcome evidence
records.summary: Defined accountabilities, events, artifacts and empirical product-development cycle

records.name: Kanban Method
records.structures: Visualize workflow, manage work in progress, control flow and improve delivery
records.evidence_needs: Work-item and flow data; lead time, throughput and WIP measures when suitable
records.summary: Visualize workflow, manage work in progress, control flow and improve delivery

records.name: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
records.structures: Break down project scope into manageable deliverables/work packages
records.evidence_needs: Scope statement and deliverable acceptance criteria
records.summary: Break down project scope into manageable deliverables/work packages

records.name: RACI / responsibility assignment
records.structures: Clarify responsibility and accountability
records.evidence_needs: Confirmed roles and decision rights
records.summary: Clarify responsibility and accountability

records.name: COBIT
records.type_note: reference framework
records.structures: Governance and management of enterprise information and technology
records.evidence_needs: Current version, objectives, capability measures and organizational context
records.summary: Governance and management of enterprise information and technology

records.name: ITIL
records.type_note: reference framework
records.structures: IT service management practices and service value system
records.evidence_needs: Service outcomes, incidents, service levels and operational data; apply the appropriate version
records.summary: IT service management practices and service value system

records.name: DeLone–McLean IS Success Model
records.structures: Relationships among system quality, information quality, use, satisfaction and net benefits
records.evidence_needs: Defined constructs and validated measures; causal interpretations require suitable evidence
records.summary: Relationships among system quality, information quality, use, satisfaction and net benefits

records.name: Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) Framework
records.structures: Technology, organizational and environmental context for adoption decisions
records.evidence_needs: Evidence for each context dimension; not a universal numerical score
records.summary: Technology, organizational and environmental context for adoption decisions

records.name: Stakeholder engagement and communication plan
records.structures: Who is affected, what each stakeholder needs, and how, when and by whom the project will communicate with them
records.evidence_needs: Confirmed stakeholders, interests, influence, messages, channels, frequency and owners
records.summary: Who is affected, what each stakeholder needs, and how, when and by whom the project will communicate with them

records.name: Lessons learned
records.structures: What worked, what did not, why, and what the next project should change
records.evidence_needs: Project records, incident and change evidence, and the people who did the work
records.summary: What worked, what did not, why, and what the next project should change

records.name: Ability–Motivation–Opportunity (AMO) Framework
records.structures: Diagnose whether performance constraints relate to ability, motivation or opportunity to contribute
records.evidence_needs: Job and performance evidence; categories should lead to testable interventions
records.summary: Diagnose whether performance constraints relate to ability, motivation or opportunity to contribute

records.name: Kirkpatrick Training Evaluation Model
records.structures: Training evaluation across reaction, learning, behavior and results
records.evidence_needs: Baselines, appropriate follow-up intervals and outcome measures; satisfaction is not proof of learning or impact
records.summary: Training evaluation across reaction, learning, behavior and results

records.name: Job Characteristics Model
records.structures: Job design through skill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy and feedback
records.evidence_needs: Job analysis and validated measures if scores are used
records.summary: Job design through skill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy and feedback

records.name: Nine-Box Talent Grid
records.structures: Structured discussion of performance and potential
records.evidence_needs: Consistent criteria, calibration and bias safeguards; not an objective measure of future success
records.summary: Structured discussion of performance and potential

records.name: Team development review using Tuckman's stages

records.structures: Organize discussion of team development and possible needs

records.summary: Organize discussion of team development and possible needs

records.name: Results-Based Management
records.structures: Objectives, indicators, monitoring, reporting and learning
records.evidence_needs: Baselines, targets, attribution/contribution limits and data quality
records.summary: Objectives, indicators, monitoring, reporting and learning

records.name: Evaluation design matrix

records.summary: Evaluation questions, indicators, sources, methods, timing and responsibilities
